metric_definition: Pooled recall of cell-weeks with detections at the stated weekly area budget. Each week, cells are ranked within the eligible non-held-out population; the budget is 10% of its national intersection area. The boundary cell contributes only the fraction needed to reach the area limit.
alt_text: Retrospective temporal test in Bolivia, 2023–2025, covering 3,127,636 cell-weeks. Dataset: 25,184,988 cell-weeks, 2013–2025. At a weekly budget of 10% of eligible area, the climatology baseline covered 39.7% and calibrated LightGBM (Bolivia Fire) 55.8% of detection-positive cell-weeks. Climatology uses training detection frequency by cell and time of year; LightGBM uses satellite detections acquired before each week. A cell-week is one 0.05-degree grid cell during a seven-day target interval. 106 of 157 test weeks met the observation requirements. Source: arXiv:2611.08539v1, Table 3.
